skeleton.parent_models: artifacts/t1_three/T1-THREE-20260929-v1 r2joint/r3mix report/final models; v0035/v0036 byte-reproduced as audit

ocovstab.reliability_signal: per-type projection_mean_distance from the frozen t1_seven n2covot operator records, PER SCOPE: report scope from REPORT_OPERATOR.json (10 common types, median 0.9491473417672116), final scope from FINAL_OPERATOR.json (11 common types incl. NCC, median 0.9498031672083602); amended 2026-10-07 pre-run: the first batch exposed that NCC lacks a report-scope distance (report split has no NCC train cells)
ocovstab.reliability_rule: type stable if its own scope's distance <= that scope's median across common types, unstable otherwise
ocovstab.donor_sampling: inverse-distance weighted systematic_indices among k nearest query cells in type pool; k=1 nearest fallback when type has fewer than knn_k cells

osoftcov.basis: f1soft soft responsibilities x n2covot covariance transport (combination of two existing routes)
osoftcov.weight_formula: logw = 0.5*log(density classifier weights) + 0.5*(gmm.predict_proba(q) @ step), bounded_weights cap log(2); f1soft frozen formula

ostabmix.basis: f2stable stability evidence x s2mix mixture carrier (combination; per-type adaptive fractions replace the global fixed ratio)
ostabmix.stability_score_rule: per type: fraction of genes with stable positive-mean direction (w1 == 1.0) from 4-part stability evidence on train cells
ostabmix.fraction_rule: fraction_best = 0.7 if score >= 0.5 else 0.3 (0.7 is s2mix's frozen proven ratio; two-level rule, no ratio scan)
ostabmix.assignment: per-type random permutation quota with frozen seed 20260921
ostabmix.non_common_types: types without a frozen fraction (stage-specific types outside density['common'], e.g. EXEM) keep the original skeleton: side 0 with the slot's own best row (identity); amended 2026-10-07 pre-run after the first batch exposed the fraction-missing gap
ostabmix.plans_location: plans.pkl per scope: shared/report/plans.pkl and shared/final/plans.pkl (locked in CACHE_LOCK.json)

nwasser.basis: new: Wasserstein geodesic displacement field (WFM lineage, non-parametric plan-based transport)
nwasser.plan: per common type: exact discrete OT plan between early-train and late-train latents on standardized dims (see plan_solver)
nwasser.displacement: early-train cell i: d_i = barycentric row projection - z_i; late-train cell j: d_j = z_j - barycentric column projection
nwasser.placement_report: target = q + distance-weighted mean displacement of k nearest early-train cells (weights 1/(dist+1e-3)); donor = nearest query cell in type pool
nwasser.placement_future: target = q + distance-weighted mean forward displacement (z_j - source_j) of k nearest late-train cells; donor = nearest query cell in type pool
nwasser.plan_solver: POT ot.emd 0.9.7.post1 exact discrete LP, uniform masses both sides, on standardized dims; amended 2026-10-07 pre-run: numpy Sinkhorn with frozen epsilon=0.05 overflowed (diverged) on raw squared-distance scale and was too slow (LSE ~0.17s/iter); POT restored usable after the 2026-10-07 env repair (user-level h5py 3.16.0 + xarray 2026.9.0 fixed the numpy-2 ABI chain); ot.emd verified 2026-10-07: marginal residuals <=1e-16, ~0.9s on the largest common type (2405x871)

nconf.basis: new: split-conformal donor radius calibration (distribution-free inference, untried in T1)
nconf.fit_rule: per common type: covot Gaussian map fit on the fit half only; nonconformity scores on the calibration half = distance(mapped target, nearest late-train latent of that type)
nconf.query_rule: donor candidates = query cells within R of the mapped target; distance-weighted systematic_indices among them; k=1 nearest fallback when none within R
nconf.plan_solver_note: nconf calibrates the covot Gaussian map (closed-form), no OT plan needed

nbidir.basis: new: forward/backward plan consistency weights (CellRank bidirectional lineage applied to donor weighting)
nbidir.consistency_sigma_rule: per type: sigma = median consistency distance over that type's train cells
nbidir.donor_weights: replace density classifier weights with consistency logw = -d^2/(2 sigma^2); d = ||backward barycentric source of dominant plan target - cell latent|| (early side) or ||forward barycentric target of dominant plan source - cell latent|| (late side); joint_donors with these weights
nbidir.plan_solver: POT ot.emd 0.9.7.post1 exact discrete LP, uniform masses both sides, on standardized dims; amended 2026-10-07 pre-run: numpy Sinkhorn with frozen epsilon=0.05 overflowed (diverged) on raw squared-distance scale and was too slow (LSE ~0.17s/iter); POT restored usable after the 2026-10-07 env repair (user-level h5py 3.16.0 + xarray 2026.9.0 fixed the numpy-2 ABI chain); ot.emd verified 2026-10-07: marginal residuals <=1e-16, ~0.9s on the largest common type (2405x871)
nbidir.plan: per common type: exact discrete OT plan between early-train and late-train latents on standardized dims (see plan_solver)

validation.split: same 60/20/20 stratified cell split as R1/t1_seven; reserved inner cells unused

candidate_policy: All non-NO_OP full-size candidates passing frozen engineering/official contract gates ship in one zip for later user-driven server arbitration; scientific proxy comparisons do not block compliant submissions
data_policy: Only official E8.5/E9.5 and frozen scored T1 components; no external data or hidden future truth
